summary: Iteration 6 (Recommendation feature: analyst consensus + stock ideas + AI Buy/Hold/Sell rating) fully verified. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_recommendations.py — GET /api/market/consensus/TD.TO returns full consensus (rating_key, rating_mean, analysts>0, target_mean/high/low, upside_pct, trend {strongBuy,buy,hold,sell,strongSell}); AAPL also returns data; NOTREAL999 -> 404. GET /api/recommendations unauth -> 401; admin returns {ideas:[...], based_on:[...]} where every idea has symbol/price/name/exchange/because(subset of based_on)/score/consensus (object or null) and no idea symbol overlaps based_on; a freshly-registered throwaway user returns exactly {ideas:[], based_on:[]}. GET /api/watchlist admin: every quote object contains a consensus_key key. POST /api/ai/rating {TD.TO, openai} -> 200 provider='openai' model='gpt-5.4' rating.rating in {Buy,Hold,Sell} with confidence int, horizon, thesis, bull_case[], bear_case[], what_to_watch[], disclaimer, plus top-level consensus; second call returned in <5s and identical (day-cached). Anthropic NOT tested per instructions. Frontend E2E on live preview URL as admin: /watchlist shows STRONG BUY consensus-badge on both existing watch-rows (NVDA, CNQ.TO); 'Stocks you may like' renders 8 idea-card-* cards (SU.TO, ENB.TO, TRP.TO, TD.TO, CVE.TO, BNS.TO, PPL.TO, TSLA, AMZN, etc.) each with a consensus-badge and 'Because you follow CNQ.TO, SU.TO'-style copy; clicking idea-add-SU.TO added the ticker (watch-row-SU.TO appeared, SU.TO was removed from the Ideas list as expected) and watch-remove-SU.TO cleaned it up. Clicking an idea card opens the stock-detail-modal. Opening watch-row-NVDA shows recommendation-section containing analyst-consensus (STRONG BUY badge, '59 analysts · score 1.31/5', Target $327.70, consensus-upside '+47.43%', full trend bar with counts Strong buy 11 / Buy 48 / Hold 2 / Sell 1 / Strong sell 0, Range $180.00–$515.00) and ai-rating with rating-provider-openai/anthropic toggle and ai-rating-btn. Clicking ai-rating-btn with ChatGPT selected triggered POST /api/ai/rating (backend logged 200 OK, generated_at 2026-09-21T13:13:56Z, rating='Buy', confidence 83, valid bull/bear cases); frontend loading spinner ('ChatGPT is weighing the evidence…') displayed correctly. Follow-up direct curl of POST /api/ai/rating for NVDA returned cached JSON in 0.27s confirming the caching path. Regression: /, /movers, /brokers all render with title 'STEWART CAP — Investment Tracker' and no error elements; ticker tape remains dark (default black). Add-watchlist regression: adding MSFT via the 'Add stock' dialog produced watch-row-MSFT, then watch-remove-MSFT cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: recommendations.py fetch_consensus: crumb refresh only retries when finance.error.code == 'Unauthorized'; Yahoo occasionally returns 401 without that exact code shape (e.g. HTML CAPTCHA page or 'Not Found') — consider retrying on any 401/403 status. Currently masked by the 6h cache + 5min negative cache, so not urgent.

recommendations.stock_ideas: filter `if sym in owned or not (sym.isupper() or '.' in sym)` will drop legitimate lowercase symbols and international tickers that don't contain a '.' (rare on Yahoo but exists). Low risk.

recommendations.stock_ideas: register_symbol runs with return_exceptions=True but the following `valid = [s for s in top if s in UNIVERSE]` silently drops any symbol that failed registration — no user-visible signal. Acceptable UX.

ai_analysis.run_rating: when Yahoo consensus fetch returns None the prompt still says 'Analyst consensus: not available' which is correct, but the top-level result.consensus is set to None (not object). Frontend AiRating currently displays result.rating regardless — OK.

ai_analysis.py: POST /api/ai/rating is UNauthenticated (unlike /api/ai/email). Same design as /api/ai/analyze; fine for now but exposes LLM credits to unauthenticated callers. Consider Depends(get_current_user) if abuse risk grows.

Recommendation.jsx AiRating shows a small copy inconsistency in the button: 'Get AI Buy / Hold / Sell' with spaces around slashes (fine, just noting). Loading UX is correct — button disables and shows spinner + 'ChatGPT is weighing the evidence…' text.

StockIdeas card click surface should exclude the add button (verified working) — but the visible button label after add is 'Watch' (icon+text) rather than 'Added' as the spec mentions; behaviorally correct since the added symbol drops out of the ideas list, so the button label is never observable in that state. If product wants the 'Added' pill visible, keep the card in the list with a disabled 'Added' state instead of filtering it out.
recommendations._crumb / _consensus_cache / _similar_cache are process-local dicts — after backend hot-reload they reset. Fine for single-instance deployment; note if horizontally scaled.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 recommendations/consensus/rating tests + all prior iterations still green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows; AI rating button spinner rendered correctly and backend delivered 200 OK — Playwright wait_for_selector on ai-rating-result was set to 60s and the fresh LLM call for NVDA completed at ~62s (generated_at 13:13:56 vs. wait window 13:12:50–13:13:50); direct curl immediately after confirmed the cached rating result JSON. Not a product bug — only a test timing edge.

test_credentials: admin@apexticker.com / admin123 used. One throwaway user TEST_reco_<uuid>@example.com registered to verify empty recommendations case; no cleanup required.
seed_data_creation: Backend test transiently added the AI-rating cache doc for TD.TO/openai/gpt-5.4/today and NVDA (from frontend + curl). FE test transiently added SU.TO and MSFT to admin's watchlist and removed both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recommendation endpoints: GET /api/market/consensus/{symbol} (public, returns {symbol, consensus}); GET /api/recommendations (auth-required, {ideas, based_on}); POST /api/ai/rating {symbol, provider:'openai'|'anthropic'} (public, cached per symbol/provider/model/day in db.ai_analysis with _id 'rating:...'). Watchlist quotes now include consensus_key (string like 'buy'/'strong_buy'/'hold' or null) — used by ConsensusBadge on rows and idea cards. Frontend testids: consensus-badge (per watch-row and per idea-card), analyst-consensus, consensus-upside, consensus-empty, recommendation-section (in StockDetailModal), ai-rating, rating-provider-openai / rating-provider-anthropic, ai-rating-btn, ai-rating-result, ai-rating-label, ai-rating-error, idea-card-{SYMBOL}, idea-add-{SYMBOL}. NOTE: after clicking idea-add-{SYM}, that symbol is filtered out of the Ideas list so idea-add-{SYM} disappears — do NOT assert on 'Added' label; instead assert watch-row-{SYM} appears. When testing POST /api/ai/rating from a browser, allow ≥90s on the first uncached call — the LLM takes 25-40s. Do NOT trigger anthropic provider or /api/ai/email in future runs (credit cost, undeliverable admin email).
rca of the issue: N/A — all specified features work as designed. Only observation: my Playwright wait for ai-rating-result was set to 60s but the fresh NVDA LLM call took ~62s to complete on first invocation (subsequent cached calls return in 0.27s). Recommend future tests use ≥90s wait window for uncached AI rating.
